profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Willis Towers Watson
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Software Test Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the financial services industry. Skilled in Test Management, Test Planning, C#, Scrum, and Software Configuration Management. Strong engineering professional with a BS focused in Computer Science from University of Texas at San Antonio.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer in Test (SDET) (TSA) (PTE)
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Worked on setting up the SW Test Automation tools that was being used for a web application.  Help train other QA engineers how to do SW test automation and the tools we are using.
- Used BDD techniques using SpecFlow in a Visual Studio environment against a web application
- Tools: Visual Studio, SpecFlow, Selenium, Protractor, Rest API, and JSON
- Used Gherkin language to specify requirements.
- Help promote the adoption of automated testing techniques in the company.
- Demo different automation technologies before adoption by the larger group of SDETs or Engineering group.
- Help create/maintain test frameworks as a Test Software Architect
- Helping in analysis of performance testing, organizing and creating test strategies / capacity planning. 
- helping SRE and doing analytics on performance of platform applications being deployed in Azure.
- Training other PTEs in doing data analysis of App Insights.  
- Writing custom KQL for reports
- Working with Databricks SW APIs creating Test Framework in C# running from Azure Pipelines.

positions.title: Principle SW Test Engineer
positions.description:
Working on SW Test Automation in San Diego on Windows Phones and other devices. Developing automated tests with C# and C++ in a variety of SW test environments provided by Microsoft (MS Unit Test, Silverlight Unit test, YMTF). Take the automated test cases and putting them in CI build system based on Jenkins pulling code from SCM of Perforce.

 Additional responsibilities is to coordinate with other sites on CI build system, testing methods, NFT, and training materials.
